partner_result_applied.result: arbitrary-orientation rank-two half-Riesz theorem and exact-rank-three Schur consequence
partner_result_applied.direct_application: For the Hadamard rank-three core, d=1/4, c=3/4 and |det Lambda_3|=1, giving ||p_Q3||_infinity <= C_*(16/3)^(1/4).

new_result.statement: For iid Uniform[0,1] inputs and the 4D Hadamard form with spectrum {1,1,-1,1/128}, writing Q=Q3+Q' with Q'=Y4^2/128 gives sup_b ||p_{Q3|Q'=b}||_infinity=infinity. For Y4=2-delta, the conditional core is delta^2 times a fixed nonconstant law, so the conditional density norm is at least 1/(3delta^2). The full QFORM output remains bounded; every physical 3x3 principal minor is -129/512 and r25 gives ||p_Q||_infinity<342.
new_result.replacement: Use the weighted scalar trace E_{Q'} ||p_{Q3|Q'}||_infinity. On the same construction p_Y4(2-delta)=(8/3)delta^3, so the coarea-weighted singular edge is O(delta), and E ||p_{Q3|Q'}||_infinity <= K 2^(2/3).

checkers.scope: algebra/constants only; not universal proof evidence

unresolved_implication: QFORM-WEIGHTED-SCALAR-TRACE-v1: prove a universal dimension-free bound on E_{Q'} ||p_{Q3|Q'}||_infinity, or an equivalent signed-Fejer/small-ball averaged conditional trace, for every full-target matrix while retaining original-coordinate product provenance and arbitrary additional spectrum.
